original.subject: Urgent: Sample 24-1189 (Zone 1 Clinic) - pH 9.6, Caustic 37 mg/L
original.body:
Sample ID: 24-1189
Source: Zone 1 (Valley) Clinic (123 Oak St)
Time collected: 10:45
pH: 9.6
Caustic dose (measured): 37 mg/L
Alert: pH > 9.5, Caustic > 40 mg/L (PLC clamp) — trigger for advisory

Additional info: Two dialysis patients from the Zone 1 (Valley) clinic have reported burning in the throat and stomach pain after consuming tap water. One is in the ER. The clinic has requested a safe water supply and has asked for a 'Do Not Use' advisory for medical and dialysis purposes.

System note: The water remains above safe limits. The control system has not recovered. The HMI continues to display normal values for NAOH-FC-203 and pH.

Attached: LIMS report with full traceability.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the advisory must now include medical use restrictions. The WQ Manager is acting on new clinical evidence, and the Director must decide whether to expand the advisory or risk harm to vulnerable populations.
